input_fields.name: coordinate_frame
input_fields.description: Explicit frame in which bounds are requested.

input_fields.name: unit
input_fields.description: Requested length unit for the six bounds.

result_fields.name: bounding_box_record
result_fields.description: Minimum/maximum coordinates, frame, unit, and measured body identity.

procedure: Resolve body_reference and coordinate_frame without changing the active model.
Read the kernel bounds once and convert only to the declared unit.
Check each minimum is no greater than its corresponding maximum and return bounding_box_record.
Do not use the box to substitute for volume, surface, or visual checks.
rejection_rules: Reject ambiguous body/frame, incompatible unit, nonfinite bounds, or reversed min/max.
Reject bounds estimated from a screenshot when kernel bounds are required.
Do not alter the model to make the bounds pass.
